sentences.text: [serious] Forty-four percent of people earning over a hundred thousand dollars live paycheck to paycheck.
Sign one: your balance is lowest the day before payday. The other side knows what's safe to spend today.
Sign two: savings is whatever's left. The other side moves savings on payday.
[pause] But you can't switch sides unless you change one thing.
Sign three: a four hundred dollar surprise goes on the credit card. On the other side, it just lowers this week's number.
